#include <riscv_vector.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <time.h>

#if defined(__riscv_vector)
#include <riscv_vector.h>
#endif

static inline void initialise_arrays(const char* function_name)
{
    (void)function_name;
}

static inline void dummy(float* a, float* b, float* c, float* d, float* e, float* aa, float* bb, float* cc, float t)
{
    (void)a;
    (void)b;
    (void)c;
    (void)d;
    (void)e;
    (void)aa;
    (void)bb;
    (void)cc;
    (void)t;
}

static inline double calc_checksum(const char* function_name)
{
    (void)function_name;
    return 0.0;
}

real_t s252(struct args_t * func_args)
{
    initialise_arrays(__func__);
    gettimeofday(&func_args->t1, NULL);

    real_t t, s;
    for (int nl = 0; nl < iterations; nl++) {
        t = (real_t)0.;
        for (int i = 0; i < LEN_1D; i++) {
            s = b[i] * c[i];
            a[i] = s + t;
            t = s;
        }
        dummy(a, b, c, d, e, aa, bb, cc, 0.);
    }

    gettimeofday(&func_args->t2, NULL);
    return calc_checksum(__func__);
}
